recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: supermarket fridges defrosting themselves across europe
citroen breathing electric life into the old 2cv silhouette
open-source mapmakers drawing a hard line on ai patches
clear october night over san francisco, ten degrees and still
autumn sunset lingering past six-thirty on the pacific coast

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a lone headlight through SF's autumn fog banks — swipe between lanes to scoop luminous mist before it blankets the road.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: Each run is one fog crossing; distance and mist collected score the round in under a minute.
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: Fog density thickens, visibility shrinks, and phantom cars drift into your lane.
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: neon wireframe against deep indigo night

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: A hacked supermarket aisle where frost spreads shelf-to-shelf — tap cells in rhythm to trigger defrost pulses before the cold grid locks up.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: Clear one aisle before the timer; combo chains feel like thawing a whole row at once.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: Frost propagation accelerates and frozen tiles split into smaller fragments.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: cold fluorescent pixel art with condensation streaks

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Flick a tiny electric runabout up terraced autumn hills — launch angle and power carry a 2CV-inspired bubble car over crests to snag vintage badges mid-air.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: Reach the next summit before 60 seconds; each hill is one satisfying arc.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: Hills steepen, crosswinds push sideways, and landing zones shrink.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: paper cutout french countryside with muted ochre fields

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Trace boundaries on a drifting map tile — separate hand-drawn contour lines from AI-generated noise before the layers merge into mush.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: Purify one tile per round; clarity percentage is the instant readout.
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: AI noise fragments multiply, rotate, and bleed into legitimate paths.
